title: Jacquard, a programming language for AI-written, human-reviewed code
claim: Show HN: Jacquard, a programming language for AI-written, human-reviewed code
why_good: Jacquard addresses the gap between AI-generated code and human oversight, making it suitable for industries requiring high reliability.
value: Companies in regulated sectors, like finance or healthcare, could pay for a subscription model that ensures compliance and quality in AI-generated code.
risk: If larger tech companies integrate similar capabilities into their existing platforms, Jacquard may struggle to differentiate itself.
